author: guitargeek
body:
PixelCPEFast and PixelCPEFastParams fetched the forWidth Lorentz angle even with useLAWidthFromDB false; fetch it only when used, as PixelCPEGeneric does.

Their errors and charge bins always come from the GenError, so with UseErrorsFromTemplates false they failed on an empty GenError store. Reject that setting in the ESProducer constructors instead, and remove the branches on it in PixelCPEFast and PixelCPEFastParamsHost, which could never work.

This is another fix for something that tripped me up when testing CMSSW on macOS.
title: Read only the pixel LA width and GenError the fast CPE uses
